suite.doc:
UAT: Performance Scale Test — 1000 MicroVMs via ReplicaSet
Creates a ReplicaSet with 1000 replicas and validates: - Operator handles scale-up without crashing - Rate limiting (RunMicrovm 5/s) is respected by quota guard - All 1000 VMs reach Running within the time budget - Status reporting is accurate (readyReplicas, currentReplicas) - Scale-down and termination completes within bounded time - No operator restarts during the entire test
Expected behaviour (us-east-1, RunMicrovm rate 5/s): - Creation throughput: ~3-4 VMs/s reaching Running - Time to 1000 Running: ~5-8 minutes (rate-limited creation + boot) - Termination rate: ~10 req/s → full drain in ~2-3 minutes
This suite is long-running (~15-20 minutes). Tag: performance Run: robot --outputdir results -i performance tests/09_performance_scale.robot
